_about: v43 (Step 21): rules for 'Changes since your last report'. Strict on purpose: when a condition is not met, nothing is shown. Validate with: python tools/check_report_blocks.py

eligibility._about: Which earlier report may be compared: same business, language, currency, industry, comparison mode, period length (and, when same_blocks is true, the same parts), and a period length that differs by at most max_length_diff_days days and max_length_diff_share of the shorter one (calendar months). It must cover an earlier period, overlap at most max_overlap_share of it, and lie at most max_gap_periods period lengths before it.

figures._about: Flow figures only. A change is reported when it is at least min_change_pct % (rates: min_change_pts points); counts also need a change of more than count_sigma times sqrt(now + before) and a base of at least min_base_count. Both periods must be fully covered by data (or have exactly the same number, at least min_data_days, of days with data). When the lengths differ, kpis listed as per_day are compared per day, kpis listed as same are compared as they are, and every other kpi (distinct customers, repeat rate) is not compared.

page1._about: How many lines of changes the first page shows (the chapters hold the rest).
